summary: Iteration 17 — Daily ad auto-pilot + Cart coverage gating. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_autopilot_iter17.py. Delivery-coverage: GET /api/delivery/coverage?lat=0&lng=0 → {covered:false, providers_in_range:0, nearest_miles:5385.5}; NYC 40.75/-73.99 → {covered:true, providers_in_range:1, nearest_miles:2.7}. Cart checkout gating: POST /api/cart/checkout with delivery_address.lat=0,lng=0 returns HTTP 409 with body {detail:{code:'no_delivery_coverage', title, message}} (FastAPI wraps the dict in 'detail'). Covered NYC address passes the gate (may 400 later for stripe origin reason, which is fine — the gate itself is what we test). Autopilot: GET /api/admin/autopilot/settings returns {enabled,daily_time_utc,shuffle,cursor,last_run_at,last_ad_id} with sensible defaults; PATCH with {enabled:true, daily_time_utc:'09:30', shuffle:false} updates and round-trips; non-admin token → 403 on both GET and PATCH (and run-now). GET /api/admin/autopilot/log returns {items:[]}. POST /api/admin/autopilot/run-now with at least one enabled webhook connector + non-empty ads library returns {ad_id, headline, summary:{ok:1,failed:0,total:1}} and writes a new autopilot_log row + advances cursor (shuffle=false). Regression: /api/admin/distribution/broadcast and /api/admin/distribution/schedule-once still return 200 for valid payloads. Frontend Admin (Playwright admin@lumo.test → /admin → Distribution): data-testid='autopilot-panel' renders at the top with all four controls — autopilot-enabled (checkbox), autopilot-time (time input pre-filled to '14:00'), autopilot-shuffle (checkbox, default checked = Random), autopilot-run-now (button). Toggling autopilot-enabled fires PATCH /api/admin/autopilot/settings immediately (verified via route interception). Clicking 'Run a cycle now' fires POST /api/admin/autopilot/run-now and returns 200 (response intercepted). Frontend Customer Cart (Playwright customer@lumo.test → /cart with one seeded item): page renders data-testid='cart-store-{sid}', 'cart-checkout-{sid}', 'cart-delivery-fee-{sid}', 'cart-us-state-{sid}'. Coverage state panels (cart-no-coverage-{sid} / cart-coverage-ok-{sid}) are conditional on the AddressInput onPlace callback — verified the BACKEND endpoint canonically (per agent-to-agent context note: 'testing the BACKEND endpoint is the canonical proof; don't burn time wrestling with Google Places'). All cleanup performed: autopilot settings restored to {enabled:false, daily_time_utc:'14:00', shuffle:true}; any TEST_ webhook connectors deleted.

critical_code_review_comments: ad_autopilot.py is clean and well-documented. _should_fire_now correctly fires once-per-day (compares last_run_at against today's target). _pick_ad supports round-robin (cursor%len) OR random shuffle. autopilot_loop iteration tolerant of exceptions.

server.py /api/cart/checkout coverage gate uses HTTPException(409, {dict}) which FastAPI serializes as {"detail": {dict}} — the test_checkout_blocked_when_uncovered handles both shapes for robustness. Spec said 'detail containing code:no_delivery_coverage' which is met.

OBSERVATION (defense-in-depth, not blocking): Cart.jsx checkout() at line 31 sends delivery_address={address: f.delivery_address} WITHOUT lat/lng, so the BACKEND coverage gate never triggers via the real UI checkout call. The UI relies on f.coverage state to disable the button client-side. If a malicious user posts to /api/cart/checkout with lat/lng, the backend correctly blocks. If they post WITHOUT lat/lng, no backend gate exists. Consider sending lat/lng from the UI (already captured by AddressInput's onPlace) so backend can also enforce, not just the UI.
Autopilot routes are correctly registered on @app (not @api) because they're added AFTER app.include_router(api). Comment in the code makes this clear.
_autopilot_broadcast safely no-ops with {total:0,ok:0,failed:0,skipped:0} when the ad doc is missing — won't crash the scheduler.
DELIVERY_CATEGORIES set covers the obvious cases (delivery, courier, errand, moving, ride_share, towing). If a new category is added to providers' role taxonomy, it must also be added here.

Minor: AutopilotSettingsBody validation does not constrain daily_time_utc to 'HH:MM' format — the _should_fire_now parser falls back to 14:00 on parse failure, so a malformed input would silently disable the fire trigger. Worth a regex validator in Pydantic.
Minor: /api/admin/autopilot/log endpoint has no time filter (only limit). For long-running operations this collection will grow unbounded. Consider a TTL index or a cleanup job.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For UI coverage panel testing in headless: Google Places autocomplete is not feasible, but you CAN drive Cart's setStoreForm directly via React internals OR simply call /api/delivery/coverage from a page.evaluate() and assert response — the spec's agent-to-agent note explicitly says backend endpoint IS the canonical proof. Autopilot run-now will use the FIRST enabled connector — if a real Discord channel is enabled, the post actually goes through, so during repeated CI runs prefer creating a temporary httpbin webhook connector and disabling existing connectors first. The Cart UI sends delivery_address.address only (no lat/lng), so backend coverage gate only matters for direct API callers and the documented UI flow that explicitly captures lat/lng on a future iteration — flagged in critical_code_review_comments.
